description: Calculate نیم‌عشر اجرایی (the state execution fee on a civil judgment): 5% of the judgment sum (Civil Judgments Enforcement Act art. 158), half on settlement and none if complied with within ten days of service of the writ (art. 160), 10% of three months' rent for an eviction (art. 159), the 1405 budget-table range for a non-financial judgment, and the Dispute Settlement Council's art. 27 exemptions for a settlement report.

kind.description: money = financial judgment; eviction = lease eviction; non_financial = non-financial or un-valued; shora_settlement = Dispute Settlement Council settlement report.

shora_timing.description: Settlement report: before the execution order (exempt), within a month of the notice (half), later.

timing.description: Court judgment: complied after ten days of service of the writ (default), within ten days, or the parties settled (half).

name: calculate_execution_fee
title: محاسبهٔ نیم‌عشر اجرایی — Calculate judgment execution fee
